name: mouse-vm
description: Transform your smartphone or tablet into a high-performance wireless trackpad, live keyboard, and desktop controller for Windows PC over WiFi.

scripts.postversion: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),v=require('./package.json').version,f='static/sw.js',s=fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8').replace(/const CACHE_NAME = \"mouse-vm-v[^\"]+\"/,'const CACHE_NAME = \"mouse-vm-v'+v+'\"');fs.writeFileSync(f,s);console.log('[postversion] sw.js CACHE_NAME updated to mouse-vm-v'+v);"
